died.name: Goar of Aquitaine
died.last_words: Here shall my Saviour be known in all the simplicity of his doctrines. Ah! would that I might witness it; but I have seen those things in a vision. But I faint! I am weary! My earthly journey is finished! Receive my blessing. Go! and be kind one to another.

died.name: Henry II of England
died.cause: on being told his son John was one of those conspiring against him
died.last_words: Now let the world go as it will; I care for nothing more.

died.name: Jan Hus
died.cause: While being burned at the stake for heresy, he saw an old woman throw a small amount of brushwood onto the fire

died.name: Thomas More
died.last_words: I die the King's good servant, and God's first.

died.name: Daniel Morgan
died.cause: when his physician advised him to settle his affairs
died.last_words: Doctor, if I could be the man I was when I was 21 years of age, I would be willing to be stripped stark naked on the top of the Alleghany Mountains to run for my life with the hounds of hell at my heels.

died.name: Sophie Blanchard
died.cause: prior to lighting fireworks that ignited the gas in her balloon, causing it to crash and Blanchard to fall to her death
died.last_words: Let's go, this will be for the last time.

died.name: Daniel Dukes
died.cause: The 27-year-old American's mutilated, naked body was found draped over Tilikum the Orca's back at SeaWorld Orlando in Florida. His death was ruled an accidental drowning after trespassing into the whale's tank.

born.name: Alexander Wilson
born.last_words: Bury me where the birds will sing over my grave.

born.name: Maximilian I of Mexico
born.cause: after being shot by firing squad
